description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate photo storage from local disk (wwwroot/uploads) to Azure Blob Storage using Managed Identity authentication
tasks.reason: The current PhotoService writes uploaded images to the local file system and deletes them with File.Delete. This approach does not scale horizontally and is incompatible with containerised or Azure-hosted deployments. Azure Blob Storage provides durable, scalable object storage with passwordless access via Managed Identity.
tasks.requirements: Replace all local file system operations in PhotoService (Directory.CreateDirectory, FileStream writes, File.Exists, File.Delete) with Azure Blob Storage SDK operations. Use DefaultAzureCredential (Managed Identity) for authentication — no storage account keys, SAS tokens, or connection strings are permitted. Register a singleton BlobServiceClient in Program.cs using the blob endpoint URI from configuration (Storage:BlobEndpoint, Storage:ContainerName). Preserve the existing IPhotoService interface signatures (GetAllPhotosAsync, GetPhotoByIdAsync, UploadPhotoAsync, DeletePhotoAsync), the SixLabors.ImageSharp dimension extraction logic, the EF Core Photo model and PhotoAlbumContext, and the delete-blob-on-DB-failure rollback behaviour. Remove the wwwroot/uploads directory creation from Program.cs. Store the blob name in Photo.StoredFileName and the full blob URL in Photo.FilePath.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities
tasks.reason: Ensuring the application is free of known security vulnerabilities is a mandatory step before any deployment to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
